note: Searched ArcGIS Hub/Online and web. Carroll County IL publishes no public parcel REST service or free parcel file. The county GIS parcel viewer (carroll.illinoisassessors.com) is subscription-only ($360/yr or $40/mo) and map/data is sold via county orders. The only ArcGIS service found under 'Carrol County' (services6 qv1nlKGEXHyUgE2M, Carrol_County_Base_Data 'Owners') is a City of Savanna account and requires a token. Commercial vendors (Regrid, Acres, Rockford Map, Dynamo, Mapping Solutions) are paid.
